text.p: The niece of Venezuelan President Rafael Caldera was kidnapped on Friday by five armed men in the western state of Carabobo, security officials said.

Josefina Sarria Pietri, a blood relative of Venezuelan first lady Alicia Pietri de Caldera, was snatched at about 8.00 a.m. (1200 GMT) from the Santa Clara ranch about 155 miles (250 km) from the capital.
Security officials, who asked not to be identified, said they had arrested three men believed to be involved in the kidnapping but had not managed to locate Sarria.

The apparent target of the kidnappers was Sarria's husband Alvaro Lecuna, a former president of the Venezuelan Central Bank. As Lecuna was not at the farm the kidnappers took Sarria instead, the officials said.
